Before you apply anywhere… read this

 Hey {{contact.first_name}},

 There’s something people never think about when they apply for funding:

 Lenders aren’t judging your “credit score.” 
 They’re judging your behavior pattern. 

 Here’s what I mean:

 Are you opening too many accounts too fast?

 Do your balances jump around unpredictably?

 Are your inquiries spaced in a way that looks risky?

 Did an old negative item randomly resurface?

 These tiny details decide approvals — not the number on your screen.

 The crazy part?

 Most people don’t even know what their profile looks like through a lender’s eyes.

 And that’s why so many get denied when they “should’ve been approved.”

 If you want the honest version of where you really stand —
